title: CIPA Wiretap, VPPA Video Pixel & HIPAA Tracker Auditor Input
description: Audit e-commerce stores, healthcare/wellness clinics, media sites, and SaaS apps via fast zero-browser HTTP for CIPA §§ 631 & 632 live-chat & session-replay wiretap exposure, VPPA 18 U.S.C. § 2710 video + ad-pixel co-presence, HIPAA / WA MHMDA sensitive intake form trackers, and CCPA/CPRA Global Privacy Control (GPC) & opt-out links.

urls.title: Target Website URLs / Bare Domains
urls.description: List of store, clinic, media, or SaaS URLs or bare domains to audit (supports full URLs like "https://clinic.example.com", bare domains like "shop.example.com", or RequestList objects like [{"url": "https://shop.example.com"}]).

url.title: Single URL or Domain (Optional Shorthand)
url.description: Optional single URL/domain convenience field for REST webhooks, Clay HTTP columns, or MCP calls.

datasetId.title: Upstream Apify Dataset ID (Optional Chaining)
datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID (e.g. from Google Maps Healthcare Scraper, Shopify Store Scraper, or Lead Finder) to auto-import URLs and deduplicate with urls.

datasetUrlField.title: Dataset URL Field Override (Optional)
datasetUrlField.description: Optional column name to extract URLs from datasetId items. When omitted, auto-detects website, url, domain, shopUrl, storeUrl, clinicUrl, practiceUrl, or appUrl.

maxLegalPagesPerDomain.title: Max Internal Intake/Video/Privacy Subpages per Site
maxLegalPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum number of discovered same-origin internal pages (/appointment, /book, /intake, /schedule, /videos, /watch, /demo, /privacy, /contact) fetched per site in addition to the homepage (0-5).

includeRemediationPack.title: Generate CIPA/VPPA Consent-Gate + Pre-Chat + GPC HTML/JS Pack
includeRemediationPack.description: Generates ready-to-paste Prior-Consent Script Gate Wrapper + Pre-Chat CIPA Recording Disclosure Widget + /.well-known/gpc.json + CCPA "Your Privacy Choices" HTML/JS snippets when compliance findings exist (+$0.01/site).

checkWiretapChatAndReplay.title: Check CIPA §§ 631/632 Session-Replay & Third-Party Chat Wiretap Risk
checkWiretapChatAndReplay.description: Detects session-replay SDKs (FullStory, Hotjar, Clarity, LogRocket, Mouseflow, etc.) and third-party live/AI chat widgets (Intercom, Drift, Zendesk, Gorgias, Tidio, etc.), verifying CMP prior-consent script gating and pre-chat recording disclosures.

checkVppaVideoPixels.title: Check VPPA (18 U.S.C. § 2710) Video + Ad-Pixel Co-Presence
checkVppaVideoPixels.description: Detects embedded video players (YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, JW Player, Mux, Vidyard, Brightcove, <video>) firing alongside ungated ad-tech identity pixels (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snap, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Criteo, Google Ads).

checkSensitiveIntakePixels.title: Check Healthcare / Sensitive Intake Form Pixel Leaks (HIPAA & WA MHMDA)
checkSensitiveIntakePixels.description: Inspects /appointment, /book, /intake, /patient, /schedule, /telehealth, and /consultation forms collecting health/appointment inputs for ungated ad pixels and session-replay scripts.

checkGpcAndOptOut.title: Check Global Privacy Control (/.well-known/gpc.json) & CCPA Opt-Out Link
checkGpcAndOptOut.description: Probes /.well-known/gpc.json and checks for "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" / "Your Privacy Choices" opt-out links when ad-tech trackers are active.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Checks domain /robots.txt rules before scanning and skips disallowed paths.

maxUrls.title: Max Sites Safety Cap
maxUrls.description: Hard ceiling on the total number of sites audited in a single run to prevent accidental budget overruns.

domainDelayMs.title: Per-Domain Polite Delay (ms)
domainDelayMs.description: Minimum polite delay in milliseconds between consecutive HTTP requests to the same hostname.

requestTimeoutMs.title: HTTP Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: Strict timeout per HTTP request in milliseconds (default 12000ms).
